import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
rows=[l.split('\t') for l in open('/app/graphene.dat') if l.strip()]
x=np.array([float(a.replace(',','.')) for a,b in rows])
y=np.array([float(b.replace(',','.')) for a,b in rows])
o=np.argsort(x); x,y=x[o],y[o]
def L(x,x0,g,a): return a*g*g/((x-x0)**2+g*g)
def model(x,c0,c1,x1,g1,a1,x2,g2,a2):
    return c0+c1/(x-680.0)+L(x,x1,g1,a1)+L(x,x2,g2,a2)
cands=[(19139.5,10289.9),(19139.5,6329.4),(19139.5,33245.0),(19139.5,3745.0),
       (10289.9,6329.4),(19139.5,27000.0),(19139.5,15000.0)]
results=[]
for x1i,x2i in cands:
    for a1i in [60000,70000]:
        p0=[19000,-15000,x1i,300,a1i,x2i,400,7000]
        try:
            p,cov=curve_fit(model,x,y,p0=p0,maxfev=50000)
            r=y-model(x,*p); sse=(r**2).sum()
            results.append((sse,p,(x1i,x2i)))
            print(f"x1i={x1i} x2i={x2i} a1i={a1i}: SSE={sse:.4e} resid_std={r.std():.1f}")
            print("   c0=%.1f c1=%.2f x1=%.2f g1=%.2f a1=%.1f x2=%.2f g2=%.2f a2=%.1f"%tuple(p))
